main.description: Get the ordered direct replies for one or more parent posts or comments from a comment feed generator. Served by the generator's service and called by the AppView, which hydrates the comments.

feed.description: AT-URI of the social.coves.feed.generator record being requested

parents.description: AT-URIs of the parent posts or comments whose replies to order

timeframe.description: Timeframe for generators ranked by top score; ignored by other generators.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page of replies. Applies only when exactly one parent is given.

errors.name: UnknownFeed
errors.description: The generator does not serve the requested feed.

errors.name: InvalidCursor
errors.description: The cursor is malformed or expired.

output.description: Ordered replies for each requested parent

reqId.description: Request ID assigned by the feed generator.
